# ACLED conflict features: with vs without (generated by scripts/acled_report.py report)

Rules fixed in `results/acled/PREREGISTRATION.md` (commit `205af44`) before training. Inputs log1p political-violence events and fatalities (DISORDER_TYPE definition) of calendar month t − k. TFT and LSTM under their Phase 3 selected conditions. DM of with vs without (HLN, Newey–West lag h − 1); p per seed with sign (− = with conflict features has lower loss). Verdict needs the sign to agree and p < 0.05 in all three seeds; Holm over the 54 seed-level tests. MASE = MAE / MAE(persistence) on the same windows; the last column is the DM verdict of each arm against persistence (absolute loss, all seeds; descriptive).

**Summary, main split (18 cells: help / hurt / no consistent difference):** squared 0 / 0 / 18; squared_holm 0 / 0 / 18; absolute 0 / 1 / 17; absolute_holm 0 / 0 / 18
